label: Stop angle

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #9 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0)

range.endpoint_anchor: stop depth index: 0.30 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.40 -> -100 = -0.10, +100 = 0.70 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.30) / 0.40)

region.mask_rule: forehead-to-nose profile band at the stop; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Profile break at the forehead-to-nose junction: + = deeper stop (dog +25), - = unbroken felid line (lion -25, cat -30). Tilts the nasal plane; the vertical STEP of the break is StopDepth (head.stop.depth) - different deformations (spec section 5.1). Values are [E] by design: no sourced numeric stop angles exist (spec section 2.3). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
